description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade speed, built‑in observability and edge‑ready deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage 2026’s hottest trends—edge computing, AI‑ready APIs, and multi‑runtime compatibility (Node, Deno, Bun). Emphasize the zero‑dependency core that slashes bundle size, the built‑in OpenTelemetry observability stack, and full TypeScript type safety without extra @types. Position Yantravese as the only framework that combines Express‑level ergonomics, Fastify‑level performance, and out‑of‑the‑box edge deployment, making it the go‑to choice for modern serverless, AI‑driven, and edge‑first applications.
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond latency: benchmarked 2‑3× faster than Express and up to 30% faster than Fastify on cold‑start edge environments.
Zero‑dependency, zero‑config core: tiny bundle (<10 KB gzipped) means instant cold starts on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, AWS Lambda, and Bun.
Full TypeScript type safety out‑of‑the‑box with no extra @types, plus built‑in OpenTelemetry for end‑to‑end observability—no extra plugins needed.
